scenariosPrimary: active Scenario and working draft state

behaviors.saveVersion: Available when the current draft can create a Version; no automatic Version creation.
behaviors.currentScenarioSelection: Selecting the current Scenario does not trigger the different-Scenario unsaved-draft guard.
behaviors.differentScenarioWithUnsavedDraft: Selection remains protected and the draft input is preserved.
behaviors.sourceNavigation: Run and Report source controls open Scenarios and select the exact source Version while retaining the active Version/draft.

persistence: ScenarioRevision, ProjectV2, local draft persistence, fingerprints, Run/Report links, and schemas are unchanged.
